title: Video: Sen. Thom Tillis calls for de-escalation of violent rhetoric after Charlie Kirk shooting
text:
This week, US Sen. Thom Tillis of North Carolina had some strong words to say about political violence in America after Charlie Kirk’s murder.
After first criticizing what he saw as violent voices on the left in the wake of the Charlie Kirk shooting, Sen. Thom Tillis of North Carolina this week went further than most Republicans in spreading that criticism among both parties.
The right, he said, also had to “look in the mirror” and tamp down the violent rhetoric. Take a look.
